h1: Attending Physician Scheduling, Done For You
paragraph: Send us your group's coverage rules, call equity and requests; we build the attending schedule and send it back finished.

cta.title: Get Your Attending Schedules Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Attending physician scheduling software is used to build faculty coverage schedules for residency and fellowship programs. Scheduling Wizard takes this a step further by operating as a fully managed service; your program submits its rules, and our team builds finished attending schedules to your coverage, call-equity and supervision rules and delivers them as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. There is no platform for your team to log into or learn.
faq.question: What is attending physician scheduling software and how does it work?

faq.answer: Coverage minimums first, then call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them. Where the department also trains residents or fellows, the attending schedule has to provide the supervision coverage the ACGME Program Requirements call for, so we build that in alongside the rest. We work from the requirements you tell us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: What rules do you build an attending schedule around?

faq.answer: No. It is entirely up to you. We build the schedule either way, and deliver it in the format and structure you want: Excel or Google Sheets, or a custom live view we build for you if that is useful. Many programs keep the platform they already have for day-to-day viewing and upload our schedules straight into it; others use the live view, or both. Whatever works best for your program.
faq.question: Does Scheduling Wizard replace the platform we use now for attending scheduling?

faq.answer: Self-service scheduling software requires someone on your team to learn, operate, and maintain a complex tool year after year. With a managed service like Scheduling Wizard, your program submits rules and receives finished attending schedules. There is no software to learn, no annual retraining when chiefs rotate, and no institutional knowledge lost when a chief leaves.
faq.question: Why is a managed service better than self-service scheduling software for attendings?

faq.answer: Not the duty hour limits; those govern residents and fellows. What an attending schedule has to provide, where the department trains, is the supervision coverage the ACGME Program Requirements call for, and we build that in alongside the group's own rules: coverage minimums, call equity, contracts, time off and requests. A group with no training program has no ACGME requirement at all, and we build to its own rules instead.
faq.question: Do ACGME duty hour rules apply to attending schedules?

faq.answer: Yes. Our team resolves dependencies across attending schedules, block rotations, call schedules, and clinic assignments simultaneously. A change in one schedule type propagates across the others, removing the manual cross-referencing and patching that causes conflicts when attending and resident schedules are built separately.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard coordinate attending and resident schedules together?
